title.narrative: Establishment of cross-border interoperable infrastructure node in Tanzania

description.narrative: UNIDO and the Government of Slovenia held consultations on 31 August 2021, suggesting to expand the portfolio related to the Fourth Industrial Revolution in the form of a project on the proliferation of blockchain technology in Tanzania. Blockchain technology holds great promise in the age of the 4IR, as it will help with a multitude of issues pertaining to transactions, verification and also security. Therefore, the suggested partner SI-Chain (the Slovenian national blockchain infrastructure) will provide the necessary expertise to build a national test and training ground. In cooperation with the National Institute of Transport, the knowledge hub and training programme could be rolled out nationally to incorporate the specific Tanzanian needs for blockchain technology. The main objective of the project is to ensure knowledge transfer, uptake of new technologies and adoption of 4IR technologies in Tanzania. Additionally, the proposal envisages to support Tanzania in accessing new markets through an improved environment that allows for verification, interoperability and reliability.
